How TIME and Statista Determined America's Top Manufacturers of 2027

For the first edition of America’s Top Manufacturers , TIME and Statista have joined forces to recognize 250 leading U.S. manufacturers. As companies navigate shifting supply chains and evolving workforce demands, the ranking highlights performance across three equally weighted dimensions: financial performance, innovation capacity, and employment.
